source: ChatGPT Slugshot Research Skills v1.1 (24 Nov 2026), Codebook v1.1: current prospective coding; v1.0 archived for the first pilot. Bump the version on every change and recode explicitly.
unit_of_analysis: one accessible post or clip; record timestamp window, language evidence and playback access

states.present: the criterion is observable in the item
states.absent: enough of the item was accessible to say it is not there
states.uncertain: ambiguous; review separately, do not force

rules: Hide metrics, ranks, sample role and performance labels before coding (`ss analyze blind-packet`); if outcomes were seen, mark the annotation unblinded.
'absent' needs full_playback or excerpt access covering the relevant moment.
Record opening, complication, attempt, reversal and payoff beats, timing, visual proof and voice/dialect as observed.
Keep meme_id, sound_id, format_id, genre_id and concept_id distinct.
Examples are invented anchors, not evidence.

codes.criterion: opening shows or voices opposing goals
explicit fictional or general rule governing the story world (stated or shown) and setting stakes for a character
codes.negative: series label without a stated rule or stake: uncertain; one-off warning without a world-wide rule, or a normal game tutorial: absent
notes: A series label ('In my world...') with no stated rule or stake: uncertain until playback shows one.
A one-off prohibition or warning for a single situation ('don't open the door at 3 AM') with no world-wide rule: absent; consider CURIOSITY_DELAY or SOCIAL_CONFLICT.
Ordinary game rules, controls or tutorials: absent.

codes.criterion: explicit alternatives with a viewer decision
a response is the central payoff
sound timed to an observable beat

changes.change: RULE_WORLD criterion clarified after the BRIEF-20261124-RULE-WORLD-PILOT pilot: series labels and one-off prohibitions. Other codes unchanged. 1.0 kept in codebooks/archive/ for validating annotations coded under it.

access_definitions.full_playback: watched the whole item with sound
access_definitions.caption_only: title, caption, tags or transcript text only
access_definitions.provider_description: the platform's or creator's description only
access_definitions.inaccessible: could not open the item; every code unreviewed
